description.en:
Operator Valarqvin has demonstrated a remarkable aptitude for assisting allies in the inflicting of elemental casualties upon the enemy.
The Field Operations Department has thus passed the following resolution:
This operator shall be appointed a Supporter Operator during field operations to exercise Ritualist responsibilities.
In witness whereof,
This badge is hereby conferred upon the above named.

description.en:
It's just a plain crystal, Arges can see that.
However, the trader not far away was touting it as the be all and end all, something about a Snowpriest's Originium Arts, Samivilinn's ward, the Cyclops' first choice... None of that could possibly be true.
She'd heard people were racketeering as pretend-Sami in the scenic parts where the Columbians parked themselves. Still, she didn't think she'd run into one on her very first time here.
She thinks to step up and put a stop to it, but as it happens, a crowd's commotion beats her to the punch.
A ne'er-do-well slips out from it, making to rob the trader of the crystal, who struggles to resist but only succeeds in pissing the assailant off. An edged weapon is thrust directly at the trader's chest, and the crowd all flinches and shuts their eyes out of fear.
And yet... with a 'thunk', the blade bounces off. Shocked, Arges catches sight of a crystal tumble out from the gash in the trader's shirt. The trader swiftly disarms the assailant of their weapon in that moment of confusion, and in an instant has the would-be killer subdued.
'It was the crystal! The crystal saved me!', the trader yells with blood still hot. 'Listen to me, these crystals bring good luck!' The words bring Arges's own mission to mind, and a thought quickly strikes.
This may well be a lucky coincidence, but... if such little moments of luck continue to accumulate, who's to say what colossal strength they could ultimately embody?
With that thought in mind, she strides over.
......
'So... that's why you bought all these crystals?'
'Yes.'
'Even though you know they're just ordinary crystals?'
'...They're very pretty, and with just a little touching-up, I can make light sources out of them too.'
'...Alright. A Cyclops who can predict the future bought a bunch of lucky crystals... You know, I think even Amma would laugh if she heard that.'
description.zh:
那是单纯的晶石，艾尔启看得出来。
然而，不远处的商贩却把它吹得天花乱坠，什么雪祀的源石技艺，萨米意志的加护，独眼巨人之选……这些根本都是不可能的事。
她听说过，在哥伦比亚人开设的景区中有人打着萨米人的名头招摇撞骗。但她没想到，她第一次来这里就遇上了。
她想要上前制止，但是，人群率先骚动了起来。
一名歹徒冲出人群，想要抢走商贩的晶石，商贩奋力反抗，却激怒了歹徒。眼看歹徒手中的利器径直刺向商贩的胸口，周围的人都恐惧得闭上了双眼。
然而……“叮”的一声，利器被弹开了，艾尔启惊讶地发现，从商贩被划开的衣服中，滚出了一块晶石。而商贩趁着歹徒愣神，瞬间夺过凶器并制服了歹徒。
商贩激动地大喊：“是晶石，是晶石救了我！相信我，这种晶石是能带来幸运的！”听着这番话，艾尔启想到了自己的使命，心中一动。
这也许是幸运的偶然，但如果，这些微小的幸运累积起来，最后说不定能够成为巨大的力量呢？
这么想着，她迈开了脚步。
……
“所以，这就是你买下这些晶石的理由？”
“是的。”
“你不是知道这是普通的晶石吗？”
“……它们很漂亮，而且只要经过改造，也可以充当光源。”
“……好吧，‘能够预言未来的独眼巨人买了几块幸运晶石’，这可能是安玛听了都会笑出来的笑话。”
